text: Bó Find is an Irish goddess who came as a magical white cow. When Ireland was barren and empty, she rose from the western sea. Her sisters came too, the red cow Bó Ruadh and the black cow Bó Dhu. The red cow went north and the black went south. Bó Find went to the island's center, and all three made life as they traveled. At the center Bó Find gave birth to twin young, one male and one female. From them came all Ireland's cattle. Places along her route still bear names with the word Bó. Her sacred island Inis Bó Find is now called Inisbofin off the Galway coast.

okr.objective: Describe Bó Find as a white cow goddess who founded Ireland's cattle.
key_results: Bó Find came as a magical white cow from the western sea.
She traveled with Bó Ruadh and Bó Dhu, the red and black cows.
She gave birth to twin calves from which all Ireland's cattle descended.
Her sacred island Inis Bó Find is now called Inisbofin.
